Trigger phrases include Steam deals, Steam discounts, Steam sales, Steam specials, 游戏打折, Steam特惠, Steam促销, 今日特惠, 游戏优惠, Steam折扣, or any request about finding cheap or discounted games on Steam. This skill provides comprehensive game information including pricing, discount percentages, developer and publisher info, genres, platform support, review scores, and more.
skills.name: steam特惠查询
